Ready to shape the future of security? 🔐
 Join Skaylink, part of Vodafone , where cloud expertise meets global scale. You'll design, advise, and implement Microsoft security solutions while supporting customer projects across different industries. Depending on your experience, you'll work independently or alongside experienced colleagues, taking ownership of projects and contributing to the evolution of our Microsoft security portfolio.
This role is remote within Romania . If you are based in Cluj-Napoca , you also have the option to work from our office in a hybrid setup.
 What You Do With Us
You design, advise on and implement Microsoft security solutions.
You support customer projects throughout all project phases, either independently or as part of a project team, depending on your experience.
You take ownership of smaller projects and progressively lead more complex customer engagements.
You collaborate closely with Microsoft on technical topics, workshop formats and our strategic partnership.
You contribute to the continuous development of Skaylink's Microsoft security portfolio.
You help define best practices and technical standards within the security team.
You share your knowledge with colleagues and actively contribute to a collaborative learning culture.
 When you fit in with us 
You have professional experience in an IT security environment (mid-level or senior).
You have hands-on experience with Microsoft security technologies and solid knowledge in one or more of the following areas:Identity & Access Protection, Threat Protection, Information Protection, Endpoint Security, Security Monitoring
You have a good understanding of Microsoft infrastructures such as Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID and Hybrid Identity.
You are passionate about IT security and eager to keep learning.
You have excellent written and spoken German and English skills.
 Nice to know: Whether you're looking to deepen your expertise as a mid-level consultant or bring years of experience to complex customer engagements, we'd love to hear from you.
 Hey, we are Skaylink.
 Join us on our Cloud Journey!
 As part of Vodafone, we bring our cloud DNA and innovative spirit to the table. Together, we are driving key cloud and transformation projects forward. From cloud migrations and security solutions to modern work projects, we create tangible added value for our customers. In doing so, we leverage synergies and combine our strengths. This results in solutions with a lasting impact and that’s exactly what makes us one of the leading providers in the field of cloud technologies.
Our goal is to deliver real results that have a measurable impact and drive projects forward in a sustainable way. We don’t just advise, we make things happen. Taking responsibility and creating impact go hand in hand.
What matters to us is your expertise, your passion, and your commitment to making a difference. Diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make us strong. They create an environment where you can contribute and grow.
If you want to do more than just follow along and you’re ready to make a real impact, Skaylink is the right place for you.
 What You Get From Us
 🎯 Purpose – using your expertise (in projects at renowned companies such as BMW Group, Henkel or KWS)
🌍 Flexibility – finding your balance (e.g. hybrid and/or remote work, flexible working hours)
📖 Development – constantly improve yourself (e.g. Skaylink Campus, development reviews and employee surveys)
💡 Innovation – contribute your ideas to advance
💻 Equipment – get off to a good start (e.g. high performance Windows laptops and a company cell phone if required)
💪 Support – Feel good (e.g. Employee referral program, Regina Maria, meal vouchers, pension plan)
🏆 Events – get together and celebrate (e.g. summer and Christmas parties, team events, cross-company tech talks)
🧩 Together – We are Skaylink!
 You + Skaylink = Perfect Match? 
 Then apply - even if you don't meet all the requirements! All we need is your CV and we can't wait to read about you.
We look forward to the (Cloud) Journey with you!
